handle_note: Edit anything in this file. The generator picks a different item / tip each day, so nothing repeats for weeks.
tips: Buying something for one exam? Ask: will I use it again after this semester?
Project team of five? You need one kit, not five.
Keep a 'once a year' list. Those are things to borrow, not buy.
A calculator sitting in your drawer earns nothing. Lend it.
Fest coming up? Borrow the outfit. Spend on the experience.
Check the item together at pickup. A quick photo protects both of you.
Return on time. Your trust score is your campus reputation.
Set your deposit close to what the item would cost to replace.
Buying a 2,000 rupee thing for a 2-hour lab? Borrow it.
Seniors have everything you need. Pool just makes asking easier.
steps: Search items listed by verified students at your college
Pick your dates and send a request. It's free
Pick it up at a spot you both know, use it, return it
